name: metamodel.removeStatus
title: Remove status from type
summary: Remove a status from a type while no element of it or of a type that extends it has the status; only the metamodel files change, and no element.
details: The status is removed from the type's own list of statuses, in the file the type is in (SR-236 AK3, AK4). A type that has no list, neither its own nor one of an ancestor, has every status: it gets the list of every status it had but this one (SR-240 AK3). A status the type has from the list of an ancestor is removed at that type. Once no type has the status, also no type without a list, its definition is removed with its lines and the comment lines directly above it, except the definition of the initial status. No element file changes and nothing in Git (D-036); no element is deleted and none changes its status (D-045, D-030). Saved filters, perspectives and mapping files that name a removed definition are listed in `mentions` and not changed (SR-236 AK7). Errors: input.invalid with details.reason unknown when no type or no status has the key (details.type, details.status); input.invalid with details.reason not-had when the type does not have the status (details.type, details.status); input.invalid with details.reason inherited when the type has the status from the list of an ancestor (details.types: the types whose list has it); input.invalid with details.reason in-use while an element of the type or of a type that extends it, in any status, has the status (SR-236 AK7; details.uses: kind, key, count and the short IDs of the first 20 elements in code-unit order); file.folder-missing when a repository of the workspace is not on this machine (details.repository, details.repositories); input.invalid with details.reason widens when a type that extends the type and has a list of its own would have more statuses (details.types); input.invalid with details.reason metamodel-invalid and the errors in details.problems when the metamodel would have an error; workspace.read-only when the metamodel files do not give a valid metamodel or the metamodel repository is not on this machine; input.invalid with details.reason git-folder when the metamodel folder is .git or a repository of its own (D-036); file.read-only when the metamodel repository cannot be written (SR-018 AK2); file.faulty when the type, a removed definition or a node on the way to them is an alias or has an anchor (details.repository, details.file, details.line); file.changed-on-disk when another process changed a file since it was read (SR-236 AK10). Nothing is written on these.
whileReadOnlyReason: SR-236 AK5: a metamodel that cannot be read is never changed (SR-011 AK3).
